label: Whatever has the nine is LORD_2, from directing by the universal intellectual cause (inference)
rule: Unfolding of supreme goodness at esse, then the directing bridge and the q.103 a.3 reading at each other being
meaning: Let g have the nine. Its supreme goodness includes causing every perfection of every other being, so in particular the being of every other being in act as to being: g is creator of all (contained by definition, not independently derived). g has intellect and will (two of the nine), so the directing bridge gives, for each other being x in act as to being, an end to which g directs x; whoever directs a thing to an end governs it (q.103 a.3 reading), so g governs x. Hence g is LORD_2. Conditional consequence; both premises stay open, and the conclusion is LORD_2, not LORD_1.
